# nsresolver Provider

Manage DNS zones, records and zone settings hosted on [NSResolver](https://nsresolver.com), through the [NSResolver API](https://api.nsresolver.com/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nsresolver = {
      source  = "ns-resolver/nsresolver"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# The token is on your NSResolver account page. Better than writing it here:
# export NSRESOLVER_TOKEN=nsr_...
provider "nsresolver" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.nsresolver.com/v1`; can also be set with `NSRESOLVER_ENDPOINT`. Only needed for testing.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Your API token, from the API token section of your NSResolver account page. Can also be set with the `NSRESOLVER_TOKEN` environment variable.
